NGA.name: Nigeria
lines: Nigeria ranks 31st of 203 countries on the composite index (score 58/100, Elevated tier; 1st = highest risk).
Within Sub-Saharan Africa it is 15th of 48 (regional median 51).
Highest-risk pillar: Governance (77); lowest-risk pillar: Social (34).
Political stability (World Bank governance indicators) improved from 31.5 (2022) to 35.1 (2025), a change of +3.6 points.
The IMF projects real GDP growth of 4.2% and inflation of 15.6% for 2026, with growth of 4.3% in 2027.
UCDP recorded 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024.
About 4.1 million people (1.7% of the population) from Nigeria were forcibly displaced in 2025 (UNHCR).
